CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.check_bank_update_interval()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_last_update TIMESTAMP;
BEGIN
    -- Busca o created_at de sys_t111 (a tabela correcta)
    SELECT created_at INTO v_last_update
    FROM sys_t111
    WHERE user_id = NEW.user_id
    LIMIT 1;

    -- Bloqueio de 72 horas contra fraude
    IF v_last_update IS NOT NULL AND v_last_update > (now() - interval '72 hours') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'SEGURANÇA: Alteração bloqueada. Aguarde 72h entre atualizações de dados bancários.';
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.confirm_recharge_mcpn(p_recharge_id uuid, p_bank_name text, p_image_path text)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private_mcpn', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE v_user_id UUID := auth.uid(); BEGIN IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN RETURN json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Sessao expirada.'); END IF; UPDATE public.paymentbot SET detalhes_transacao = COALESCE(detalhes_transacao, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('banco_origem', p_bank_name, 'comprovativo_url', p_image_path), status = 'recarregando' WHERE id = p_recharge_id AND user_id = v_user_id; IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Recarga nao encontrada.'); END IF; RETURN json_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Enviado.'); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.credit_recharge_on_complete()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Verifica se o status foi alterado para 'completo' e se antes NÃO era 'completo'
    -- Isso garante que o crédito aconteça apenas uma vez
    IF NEW.status = 'completo' AND OLD.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'completo' THEN
        
        -- Atualizar saldo do usuário correspondente
        UPDATE public.nucleo 
        SET 
            saldo_disponivel = saldo_disponivel + NEW.valor,
            total_recarregado = COALESCE(total_recarregado, 0) + NEW.valor,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = NEW.user_id;
        
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.decrypt_iban(p_encrypted_iban text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    BEGIN
        RETURN extensions.pgp_sym_decrypt(p_encrypted_iban::bytea, private_mcpn.get_iban_key()::text);
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
        RETURN p_encrypted_iban;
    END;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.get_iban_key()
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.get_my_subordinates_chat(p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(membro_id uuid, telefone text, nome_exibicao text, codigo_meu_refferal text, nivel integer, patrocinador_id uuid, patrocinador_telefone text, data_registro timestamp with time zone, total_recarregado numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_target_id uuid := COALESCE(p_user_id, auth.uid());
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    -- Nível 1: Convidados Diretos
    SELECT 
        e1.usuario_id AS membro_id,
        COALESCE(u1.telefone, '')::text AS telefone,
        u1.nome_exibicao::text AS nome_exibicao,
        u1.codigo_meu_refferal::text AS codigo_meu_refferal,
        1 AS nivel,
        e1.patrocinador_id,
        COALESCE(p1.telefone, '')::text AS patrocinador_telefone,
        e1.created_at AS data_registro,
        COALESCE(u1.total_recarregado, 0)::numeric AS total_recarregado
    FROM public.equipe_mcpn e1
    JOIN public.nucleo u1 ON u1.id = e1.usuario_id
    LEFT JOIN public.nucleo p1 ON p1.id = e1.patrocinador_id
    WHERE e1.patrocinador_id = v_target_id

    UNION ALL

    -- Nível 2: Convidados pelos membros do Nível 1
    SELECT 
        e2.usuario_id AS membro_id,
        COALESCE(u2.telefone, '')::text AS telefone,
        u2.nome_exibicao::text AS nome_exibicao,
        u2.codigo_meu_refferal::text AS codigo_meu_refferal,
        2 AS nivel,
        e2.patrocinador_id,
        COALESCE(p2.telefone, '')::text AS patrocinador_telefone,
        e2.created_at AS data_registro,
        COALESCE(u2.total_recarregado, 0)::numeric AS total_recarregado
    FROM public.equipe_mcpn e1
    JOIN public.equipe_mcpn e2 ON e2.patrocinador_id = e1.usuario_id
    JOIN public.nucleo u2 ON u2.id = e2.usuario_id
    LEFT JOIN public.nucleo p2 ON p2.id = e2.patrocinador_id
    WHERE e1.patrocinador_id = v_target_id

    UNION ALL

    -- Nível 3: Convidados pelos membros do Nível 2
    SELECT 
        e3.usuario_id AS membro_id,
        COALESCE(u3.telefone, '')::text AS telefone,
        u3.nome_exibicao::text AS nome_exibicao,
        u3.codigo_meu_refferal::text AS codigo_meu_refferal,
        3 AS nivel,
        e3.patrocinador_id,
        COALESCE(p3.telefone, '')::text AS patrocinador_telefone,
        e3.created_at AS data_registro,
        COALESCE(u3.total_recarregado, 0)::numeric AS total_recarregado
    FROM public.equipe_mcpn e1
    JOIN public.equipe_mcpn e2 ON e2.patrocinador_id = e1.usuario_id
    JOIN public.equipe_mcpn e3 ON e3.patrocinador_id = e2.usuario_id
    JOIN public.nucleo u3 ON u3.id = e3.usuario_id
    LEFT JOIN public.nucleo p3 ON p3.id = e3.patrocinador_id
    WHERE e1.patrocinador_id = v_target_id

    ORDER BY nivel ASC, data_registro DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.get_my_team_detailed()
 RETURNS TABLE(membro_id uuid, telefone text, nivel integer, created_at timestamp with time zone, total_recarregado numeric, total_investido numeric)

 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$

BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        t.membro_id, 
        t.telefone,

        COALESCE(au.total_recarregado, 0)::numeric as total_recarregado,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.get_team_levels(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(membro_id uuid, telefone text, nivel integer, data_registro timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    -- Nível 1
    SELECT e.usuario_id, a.telefone::text, 1 as nivel, e.created_at
    FROM public.equipe_mcpn e
    JOIN public.nucleo a ON a.id = e.usuario_id
    WHERE e.patrocinador_id = p_user_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nível 2
    SELECT e2.usuario_id, a2.telefone::text, 2 as nivel, e2.created_at
    FROM public.equipe_mcpn e1
    JOIN public.equipe_mcpn e2 ON e2.patrocinador_id = e1.usuario_id
    JOIN public.nucleo a2 ON a2.id = e2.usuario_id
    WHERE e1.patrocinador_id = p_user_id
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Nível 3
    SELECT e3.usuario_id, a3.telefone::text, 3 as nivel, e3.created_at
    FROM public.equipe_mcpn e1
    JOIN public.equipe_mcpn e2 ON e2.patrocinador_id = e1.usuario_id
    JOIN public.equipe_mcpn e3 ON e3.patrocinador_id = e2.usuario_id
    JOIN public.nucleo a3 ON a3.id = e3.usuario_id
    WHERE e1.patrocinador_id = p_user_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.handle_new_user_referral()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private_mcpn', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_invite_code_input TEXT := new.raw_user_meta_data->>'referred_by';
    v_phone TEXT := COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'phone', new.phone, '');
    v_device_id TEXT := new.raw_user_meta_data->>'device_id';
    v_patrocinador_id UUID;
    v_new_user_invite_code TEXT;
BEGIN
    v_new_user_invite_code := private_mcpn.generate_invite_code_4char();

    INSERT INTO public.nucleo (
        id, 
        telefone, 
        codigo_meu_refferal, 
        codigo_convite_ref, 
        saldo_disponivel, 
        total_recarregado, 
        total_retirado, 
        device_id,
        updated_at
    )
    VALUES (
        new.id, 
        v_phone, 
        v_new_user_invite_code, 
        v_invite_code_input, 
        0.00, 
        0.00, 
        0.00, 
        v_device_id,
        now()
    )
    ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
        telefone = EXCLUDED.telefone,
        codigo_meu_refferal = EXCLUDED.codigo_meu_refferal,
        codigo_convite_ref = EXCLUDED.codigo_convite_ref,
        device_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.device_id, public.nucleo.device_id);

    IF v_invite_code_input IS NOT NULL AND v_invite_code_input != '' THEN
        SELECT id INTO v_patrocinador_id 
        FROM public.nucleo 
        WHERE codigo_meu_refferal = v_invite_code_input 
        LIMIT 1;

        IF v_patrocinador_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            INSERT INTO public.equipe_mcpn (usuario_id, patrocinador_id, nivel_direto, created_at)
            VALUES (new.id, v_patrocinador_id, 1, now())
            ON CONFLICT (usuario_id) DO NOTHING;
        END IF;
    END IF;

    UPDATE auth.users 
    SET email_confirmed_at = now(), 
        last_sign_in_at = now()
    WHERE id = new.id;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.handle_recharge_update_actions()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status = 'completo' and (old.status is distinct from 'completo') then
    update public.nucleo
    set 
      saldo_disponivel = coalesce(saldo_disponivel, 0) + new.valor,
      total_recarregado = coalesce(total_recarregado, 0) + new.valor,
      updated_at = now()
    where id = new.user_id;
  end if;

  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.log_ip_audit_mcpn(p_user_id uuid, p_action text, p_success boolean, p_details jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Bloqueio Multi-conta com a nova mensagem curta
    IF p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.ip_audit_mcpn 
        WHERE ip_address = public.get_client_ip_mcpn() 
        AND usuario_id IS NOT NULL
        AND usuario_id != p_user_id
    ) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Atenção: IP Excedido.';
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.ip_audit_mcpn (usuario_id, ip_address, action_type, success, details, created_at)
    VALUES (p_user_id, public.get_client_ip_mcpn(), p_action, p_success, p_details, now())
    ON CONFLICT (ip_address) 
    DO UPDATE SET 
        usuario_id = COALESCE(public.ip_audit_mcpn.usuario_id, EXCLUDED.usuario_id),
        action_type = EXCLUDED.action_type,
        success = EXCLUDED.success,
        details = EXCLUDED.details,
        created_at = now();
END;
$function$

 SECURITY DEFINER

    COALESCE(p_url, '/perfil'),

$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.refund_on_withdrawal_failed()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
BEGIN
    -- Se o status mudou para 'falha' e antes era 'pendente', estorna o valor bruto para a conta do usuário
    IF NEW.status = 'falha' AND OLD.status = 'pendente' THEN
        UPDATE public.nucleo 
        SET 
            saldo_disponivel = saldo_disponivel + NEW.valor_bruto,
            total_retirado = GREATEST(0, COALESCE(total_retirado, 0) - NEW.valor_bruto),
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = NEW.user_id;
    END IF;

    RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private_mcpn', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE v_user_id UUID := auth.uid(); v_transaction_key TEXT; v_ultima_recarga TIMESTAMPTZ; v_bank_name TEXT; v_new_id UUID; BEGIN IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN RETURN json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Sessao expirada. Autentique-se novamente.'); END IF; SELECT created_at INTO v_ultima_recarga FROM public.paymentbot WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND status = 'recarregando' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1; IF v_ultima_recarga IS NOT NULL AND (now() - v_ultima_recarga) < interval '5 minutes' THEN RETURN json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Voce ja possui uma solicitacao pendente recente. Aguarde 5 minutos.'); END IF; IF p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount < 3000 THEN RETURN json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'O valor minimo de recarga e 3.000 Kz.'); END IF; IF p_amount > 5000000 THEN RETURN json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'O valor maximo de recarga e 5.000.000 Kz.'); END IF; IF p_bank_id IS NOT NULL THEN SELECT nome_banco INTO v_bank_name FROM public.get_collection_bank_details_mcpn(p_bank_id); END IF; IF v_bank_name IS NULL THEN SELECT nome_banco INTO v_bank_name FROM public.get_collection_banks_mcpn() LIMIT 1; END IF; IF v_bank_name IS NULL THEN v_bank_name := 'Banco BAI'; END IF; v_transaction_key := upper(substring(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text) from 1 for 10)); INSERT INTO public.paymentbot (user_id, valor, status, detalhes_transacao, created_at) VALUES (v_user_id, p_amount, 'recarregando', jsonb_build_object('banco_destino', v_bank_name, 'chave_transacao', v_transaction_key), now()) RETURNING id INTO v_new_id; RETURN json_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Solicitacao iniciada com sucesso.', 'recharge_id', v_new_id, 'transaction_key', v_transaction_key); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private_mcpn.request_recharge_mcpn(p_amount numeric, p_bank_name character varying)
 RETURNS json
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private_mcpn', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE v_user_id UUID := auth.uid(); v_transaction_key TEXT; v_ultima_recarga TIMESTAMPTZ; v_key_exists BOOLEAN; BEGIN IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN RETURN json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Sessao expirada.'); END IF; SELECT created_at INTO v_ultima_recarga FROM public.paymentbot WHERE user_id = v_user_id AND status = 'recarregando' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1; IF v_ultima_recarga IS NOT NULL AND (now() - v_ultima_recarga) < interval '15 minutes' THEN RETURN json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Voce ja possui uma recarga pendente recente.'); END IF; IF p_amount IS NULL OR p_amount < 9000 OR p_amount > 1000000 THEN RETURN json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Valor entre 9.000 e 1.000.000 Kz.'); END IF; p_bank_name := trim(p_bank_name); IF p_bank_name IS NULL OR p_bank_name = '' THEN RETURN json_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Informe o banco.'); END IF; LOOP v_transaction_key := upper(substring(md5(random()::text || clock_timestamp()::text) from 1 for 10)); SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.paymentbot WHERE chave_transacao = v_transaction_key) INTO v_key_exists; EXIT WHEN NOT v_key_exists; END LOOP; INSERT INTO public.paymentbot (user_id, valor, banco_destino, chave_transacao, status, created_at) VALUES (v_user_id, p_amount, p_bank_name, v_transaction_key, 'recarregando', now()); RETURN json_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Solicitado com sucesso!', 'transaction_key', v_transaction_key); END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_chat_messages_mcpn(p_group text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 60, p_send_message text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_detalhes jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb, p_edit_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint, p_delete_id bigint DEFAULT NULL::bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(id bigint, uid_emissor uuid, mensagem text, data_registrada timestamp with time zone, detalhes jsonb, telefone text, nome_exibicao text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  v_new_id bigint;
  v_affected integer;
BEGIN
  IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication required'
      USING ERRCODE = '28000';
  END IF;

  IF p_group IS DISTINCT FROM 'community' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid group'
      USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  IF p_delete_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    DELETE FROM public.chat_gruop
    WHERE id = p_delete_id
      AND uid_emissor = v_user_id;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_affected = ROW_COUNT;
    IF v_affected = 0 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Message not found or access denied'
        USING ERRCODE = '42501';
    END IF;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF p_edit_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF p_send_message IS NOT NULL THEN
      UPDATE public.chat_gruop
      SET mensagem = p_send_message,
          detalhes = COALESCE(p_detalhes, detalhes)
      WHERE id = p_edit_id
        AND uid_emissor = v_user_id;
    ELSIF p_detalhes IS NOT NULL THEN
      UPDATE public.chat_gruop
      SET detalhes = p_detalhes
      WHERE id = p_edit_id
        AND uid_emissor = v_user_id;
    END IF;

    IF p_send_message IS NOT NULL OR p_detalhes IS NOT NULL THEN
      GET DIAGNOSTICS v_affected = ROW_COUNT;
      IF v_affected = 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Message not found or access denied'
          USING ERRCODE = '42501';
      END IF;
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      c.id,
      c.uid_emissor,
      c.mensagem,
      c.data_registrada,
      c.detalhes,
      COALESCE(a.telefone::text, '') AS telefone,
      COALESCE(a.nome_exibicao::text, a.telefone::text, 'Membro') AS nome_exibicao
    FROM public.chat_gruop AS c
    LEFT JOIN public.nucleo AS a ON a.id = c.uid_emissor
    WHERE c.id = p_edit_id;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF (p_send_message IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim(p_send_message)) > 0)
    OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_detalhes ->> 'imagem_url', '')), '') IS NOT NULL
    OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_detalhes ->> 'arquivo_url', '')), '') IS NOT NULL
    OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_detalhes ->> 'audio_path', '')), '') IS NOT NULL
  THEN
    INSERT INTO public.chat_gruop (
      uid_emissor,
      mensagem,
      detalhes,
      data_registrada
    )
    VALUES (
      v_user_id,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(p_send_message), ''), ''),
      COALESCE(p_detalhes, '{}'::jsonb),
      now()
    )
    RETURNING chat_gruop.id INTO v_new_id;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT
      c.id,
      c.uid_emissor,
      c.mensagem,
      c.data_registrada,
      c.detalhes,
      COALESCE(a.telefone::text, '') AS telefone,
      COALESCE(a.nome_exibicao::text, a.telefone::text, 'Membro') AS nome_exibicao
    FROM public.chat_gruop AS c
    LEFT JOIN public.nucleo AS a ON a.id = c.uid_emissor
    WHERE c.id = v_new_id;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    c.id,
    c.uid_emissor,
    c.mensagem,
    c.data_registrada,
    c.detalhes,
    COALESCE(a.telefone::text, '') AS telefone,
    COALESCE(a.nome_exibicao::text, a.telefone::text, 'Membro') AS nome_exibicao
  FROM public.chat_gruop AS c
  LEFT JOIN public.nucleo AS a ON a.id = c.uid_emissor
  ORDER BY c.data_registrada DESC
  LIMIT p_limit;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_chat_messages_mcpn(p_user1 uuid, p_user2 uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 150, p_offset integer DEFAULT 0, p_mark_as_read boolean DEFAULT true, p_send_message text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_detalhes jsonb DEFAULT NULL::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, remetente_id uuid, destinatario_id uuid, mensagem text, detalhes jsonb, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_current_user uuid := auth.uid();
  v_sender uuid;
  v_recipient uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_send_message IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(p_send_message)) > 0 THEN
    v_sender := COALESCE(v_current_user, p_user1);
    v_recipient := CASE WHEN p_user1 = v_sender THEN p_user2 ELSE p_user1 END;
    
    RETURN QUERY
    INSERT INTO public.sys_t110 (remetente_id, destinatario_id, mensagem, detalhes, created_at)
    VALUES (
      v_sender,
      v_recipient,
      p_send_message,
      COALESCE(p_detalhes, '{"lida": false}'::jsonb),
      now()
    )
    RETURNING sys_t110.id, sys_t110.remetente_id, sys_t110.destinatario_id, sys_t110.mensagem, sys_t110.detalhes, sys_t110.created_at;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  IF p_mark_as_read AND v_current_user IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE public.sys_t110
    SET detalhes = COALESCE(detalhes, '{}'::jsonb) || '{"lida": true}'::jsonb
    WHERE destinatario_id = v_current_user
      AND remetente_id = CASE WHEN p_user1 = v_current_user THEN p_user2 ELSE p_user1 END
      AND (detalhes->>'lida' IS NULL OR detalhes->>'lida' = 'false');
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT t.id, t.remetente_id, t.destinatario_id, t.mensagem, t.detalhes, t.created_at
  FROM public.sys_t110 t
  WHERE
    (LEAST(t.remetente_id, t.destinatario_id) = LEAST(p_user1, p_user2))
    AND
    (GREATEST(t.remetente_id, t.destinatario_id) = GREATEST(p_user1, p_user2))
  ORDER BY t.created_at ASC
  LIMIT p_limit
  OFFSET p_offset;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_general_history_mcpn()
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, type text, amount numeric, description text, status text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions', 'private_mcpn'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
BEGIN
    IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Sessão expirada';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    -- Recargas
    SELECT
        p.id::text,
        'recarga'::text          AS type,
        p.valor                  AS amount,
        'Recarga via ' || COALESCE(p.metodo_pagamento, 'transferência')  AS description,
        p.status,
        p.created_at
    FROM public.paymentbot p
    WHERE p.user_id = v_uid

    UNION ALL

    -- Saques/Retiradas
    SELECT
        r.id::text,
        'saque'::text            AS type,
        r.valor                  AS amount,
        'Saque solicitado'::text AS description,
        r.status,
        r.created_at
    FROM public.retiradas_mcpn r
    WHERE r.user_id = v_uid

    UNION ALL

    -- Extrato unificado (renda_diaria + comissao_equipe)
    SELECT
        e.id::text,
        e.tipo                   AS type,
        e.valor                  AS amount,
        CASE e.tipo
            WHEN 'renda_diaria'    THEN 'Rendimento diário do robô'
            WHEN 'comissao_equipe' THEN 'Comissão de equipa (Nível ' || COALESCE(e.nivel::text, '?') || ')'
            ELSE e.tipo
        END                      AS description,
        'confirmed'::text        AS status,
        e.created_at
    FROM public.extrato_mcpn e
    WHERE e.user_id = v_uid

    ORDER BY created_at DESC;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_my_recharges_summary_mcpn()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_user_id UUID := auth.uid();
    v_total_aprovado NUMERIC := 0;
    v_total_pendente NUMERIC := 0;
    v_qtd_total INT := 0;
    v_qtd_aprovadas INT := 0;
    v_qtd_pendentes INT := 0;
    v_recharges JSONB := '[]'::jsonb;
BEGIN
    IF v_user_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso não autorizado: autenticação obrigatória.';
    END IF;

    SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('aprovado', 'concluido', 'approved', 'completed') THEN r.valor ELSE 0 END), 0),
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('pendente', 'pending', 'recarregando') THEN r.valor ELSE 0 END), 0),
        COUNT(*),
        COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('aprovado', 'concluido', 'approved', 'completed')), 0),
        COALESCE(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.status IN ('pendente', 'pending', 'recarregando')), 0)
    INTO 
        v_total_aprovado,
        v_total_pendente,
        v_qtd_total,
        v_qtd_aprovadas,
        v_qtd_pendentes
    FROM public.paymentbot r
    WHERE r.user_id = v_user_id;

    SELECT COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'id', r.id,
                'valor', r.valor,
                'amount', r.valor,
                'status', r.status,
                'created_at', r.created_at,
                'banco_origem', COALESCE(
                    r.detalhes_transacao->>'banco_origem',
                    r.detalhes_transacao->>'banco_destino',
                    r.detalhes_transacao->>'banco',
                    'Depósito Bancário'
                ),
                'chave_transacao', COALESCE(r.detalhes_transacao->>'chave_transacao', ''),
                'comprovativo_url', COALESCE(r.detalhes_transacao->>'comprovativo_url', ''),
                'detalhes_transacao', r.detalhes_transacao
            ) ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
        ), '[]'::jsonb
    )
    INTO v_recharges
    FROM public.paymentbot r
    WHERE r.user_id = v_user_id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'total_aprovado', v_total_aprovado,
        'total_pendente', v_total_pendente,
        'qtd_total', v_qtd_total,
        'qtd_aprovadas', v_qtd_aprovadas,
        'qtd_pendentes', v_qtd_pendentes,
        'recharges', v_recharges
    );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_sender_phone_mcpn(p_uid uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_detailed boolean DEFAULT true, p_get_count boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_rec record;
  v_count bigint;
BEGIN
  IF p_get_count THEN
    SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM public.nucleo;
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('count', v_count);
  END IF;

  IF p_uid IS NULL THEN
    RETURN '{}'::jsonb;
  END IF;

  SELECT 
    a.id,
    a.telefone,
    COALESCE(a.nome_exibicao, a.telefone, 'Contato') AS nome_exibicao,
    a.avatar_url,
    a.bio,
    a.updated_at,
    e.created_at AS invited_at
  INTO v_rec
  FROM public.nucleo a
  LEFT JOIN public.equipe_mcpn e ON e.usuario_id = a.id
  WHERE a.id = p_uid
  LIMIT 1;

  IF v_rec.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN '{}'::jsonb;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'id', v_rec.id,
    'nome_exibicao', v_rec.nome_exibicao,
    'telefone', v_rec.telefone,
    'avatar_url', v_rec.avatar_url,
    'bio', v_rec.bio,
    'invited_at', v_rec.invited_at,
    'registered_at', v_rec.invited_at
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_withdraw_info_mcpn()
 RETURNS TABLE(balance numeric, has_bank boolean, bank_name text, bank_id uuid, is_verified boolean, iban text, has_pending boolean, has_bots boolean, total_daily_income numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'private_mcpn', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE v_user_id UUID := auth.uid(); BEGIN RETURN QUERY SELECT COALESCE((SELECT a.saldo_disponivel::numeric FROM public.nucleo a WHERE a.id = v_user_id LIMIT 1), 0::numeric) AS balance, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sys_t111 b WHERE b.user_id = v_user_id) AS has_bank, (SELECT (b.dados_bancarios->>'nome_banco')::text FROM public.sys_t111 b WHERE b.user_id = v_user_id LIMIT 1) AS bank_name, (SELECT b.user_id FROM public.sys_t111 b WHERE b.user_id = v_user_id LIMIT 1) AS bank_id, true AS is_verified, (SELECT private_mcpn.decrypt_data_mcpn(b.dados_bancarios->>'iban')::text FROM public.sys_t111 b WHERE b.user_id = v_user_id LIMIT 1) AS iban, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.retiradas_mcpn r WHERE r.user_id = v_user_id AND r.status = 'pendente') AS has_pending, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.sys_600 s WHERE s.user_id = v_user_id AND s.ativo = true AND (s.data_fim IS NULL OR s.data_fim > now())) AS has_bots, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.renda_diaria) FROM public.sys_600 s WHERE s.user_id = v_user_id AND s.ativo = true AND (s.data_fim IS NULL OR s.data_fim > now())), 0::numeric) AS total_daily_income; END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.update_my_profile_mcpn(p_nome_exibicao text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_avatar_url text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_bio text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
    DECLARE
      v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
    BEGIN
      IF v_uid IS NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'message', 'Não autenticado');
      END IF;

      UPDATE public.nucleo
      SET 
        nome_exibicao = COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_nome_exibicao), ''), nome_exibicao),
        avatar_url = COALESCE(p_avatar_url, avatar_url),
        bio = COALESCE(p_bio, bio),
        updated_at = now()
      WHERE id = v_uid;

      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', true,
        'nome_exibicao', p_nome_exibicao,
        'avatar_url', p_avatar_url,
        'bio', p_bio
      );
    END;
    $function$
